plugins.cameraPermission: BorrowVault uses your camera to take handover and return photos of the item, so you and your neighbour both have a time-stamped record of its condition. Photos are taken only when you tap the shutter.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: BorrowVault reads your location only at the moment you take a handover or return photo, to confirm it was taken inside your society. We never track you in the background.

plugins.photosPermission: BorrowVault lets you pick photos from your gallery for your listings and your address proof. Handover and return photos always use the in-app camera.
plugins.cameraPermission: BorrowVault uses your camera to photograph your address proof (for example, a maintenance bill or rent agreement) for your society admin to verify.
